read_lines =: 3 : '<;._2 (1!:1 <y)'
split_words =: 3 : '<;._1 '' '',y'
read_inputs =: 3 : 0
    ids =. 0$a:
    points =. 0 2$0.0
    for_line. }.read_lines 'input/points.csv' do.
        fields =. <;._1 ',',>line
        ids =. ids,{.fields
        points =. points,".&>}.fields
    end.
    initial =. 5$<0 6$0.0
    count =. 0
    weights =. i.0
    for_line. read_lines 'input/init.txt' do.
        if. 0=#>line do.
            continue.
        end.
        fields =. split_words >line
        select. {.0{::fields
        case. 'K' do.
            count =. ".1{::fields
        case. 'W' do.
            weights =. ".&>}.fields
        case. 'C' do.
            component =. <:".1{::fields
            row =. (component{weights),".&>2}.fields
            initial =. (<(count{::initial),row)count}initial
        end.
    end.
    parameters =. 0$a:
    for_line. read_lines 'input/params.txt' do.
        fields =. split_words >line
        if. 'TYPES'-:0{::fields do.
            parameters =. parameters,<}.fields
        else.
            parameters =. parameters,<".&>}.fields
        end.
    end.
    (<ids),(<points),(<initial),<parameters
)

adjust_model =: 4 : 0
    model =. y
    count =. #model
    shared =. 3$0.0
    if. x-:'TIED' do.
        for_column. i.3 do.
            total =. 0.0
            for_component. model do.
                total =. total+(0{component)*(column+3){component
            end.
            shared =. total column}shared
        end.
    end.
    for_k. i.count do.
        row =. k{model
        if. x-:'DIAG' do.
            row =. 0.0 4}row
        elseif. x-:'SPHERICAL' do.
            variance =. ((3{row)+5{row)%2.0
            row =. (variance,0.0,variance)3 4 5}row
        elseif. x-:'TIED' do.
            row =. shared 3 4 5}row
        end.
        model =. row k}model
    end.
    model
)
expectation =: 4 : 0
    model =. y
    records =. (0,#model)$0.0
    densities =. i.0
    loglik =. 0.0
    for_point. x do.
        scores =. i.0
        for_component. model do.
            scores =. scores,point weighted_log_density component
        end.
        maximum =. >./scores
        row =. ^scores-maximum
        total =. 0.0
        for_value. row do.
            total =. total+value
        end.
        density =. maximum+^.total
        records =. records,row%total
        densities =. densities,density
        loglik =. loglik+density
    end.
    (<records),(<densities),<loglik
)
maximization =: 4 : 0
    points =. x
    'records kind epsilon' =. y
    count =. 1{$records
    sample_size =. #points
    model =. 0 6$0.0
    counts =. i.0
    scatter =. 0 3$0.0
    for_k. i.count do.
        nk =. 0.0
        sx =. 0.0
        sy =. 0.0
        for_i. i.sample_size do.
            r =. (<i,k){records
            nk =. nk+r
            sx =. sx+r*(<i,0){points
            sy =. sy+r*(<i,1){points
        end.
        mx =. sx%nk
        my =. sy%nk
        counts =. counts,nk
        model =. model,(nk%sample_size),mx,my,0.0,0.0,0.0
        a =. 0.0
        b =. 0.0
        c =. 0.0
        for_i. i.sample_size do.
            'dx dy' =. (i{points)-mx,my
            r =. (<i,k){records
            a =. a+(r*dx)*dx
            b =. b+(r*dx)*dy
            c =. c+(r*dy)*dy
        end.
        scatter =. scatter,a,b,c
    end.
    if. kind-:'TIED' do.
        shared =. 3$0.0
        for_column. i.3 do.
            total =. 0.0
            for_row. scatter do.
                total =. total+column{row
            end.
            shared =. (total%sample_size)column}shared
        end.
        shared =. shared+epsilon,0.0,epsilon
        for_k. i.count do.
            row =. shared 3 4 5}k{model
            model =. row k}model
        end.
    else.
        for_k. i.count do.
            'a b c' =. (k{scatter)%k{counts
            a =. a+epsilon
            c =. c+epsilon
            if. kind-:'DIAG' do.
                b =. 0.0
            elseif. kind-:'SPHERICAL' do.
                variance =. ((((<k,0){scatter)%k{counts)+((<k,2){scatter)%k{counts)%2.0
                a =. variance+epsilon
                b =. 0.0
                c =. variance+epsilon
            end.
            row =. (a,b,c)3 4 5}k{model
            model =. row k}model
        end.
    end.
    model
)
run_em =: 3 : 0
    'points initial kind iterations epsilon' =. y
    model =. kind adjust_model initial
    'records densities loglik' =. points expectation model
    trace =. ,loglik
    for_iteration. i.iterations do.
        model =. points maximization (<records),(<kind),<epsilon
        'records densities loglik' =. points expectation model
        trace =. trace,loglik
    end.
    (<model),(<records),(<densities),<trace
)

Pi =: 1p1
determinant =: 3 : '((0{y)*2{y)-*:1{y'
mahalanobis =: 4 : 0
    'weight mx my a b c' =. y
    'dx dy' =. x-mx,my
    ((((c*dx)*dx)-((2.0*b)*dx)*dy)+(a*dy)*dy)%determinant a,b,c
)
weighted_log_density =: 4 : 0
    (((^.0{y)-^.2.0*Pi)-(^.determinant 3}.y)%2.0)-(x mahalanobis y)%2.0
)
eigen_data =: 3 : 0
    'a b c' =. y
    h =. (a+c)%2.0
    delta =. (a-c)%2.0
    g =. %:(delta*delta)+b*b
    leading =. h+g
    trailing =. h-g
    ux =. 1.0
    uy =. 0.0
    if. b=0.0 do.
        if. a<c do.
            ux =. 0.0
            uy =. 1.0
        end.
    else.
        if. a>:c do.
            vx =. leading-c
            vy =. b
        else.
            vx =. b
            vy =. leading-a
        end.
        length =. %:(vx*vx)+vy*vy
        ux =. vx%length
        uy =. vy%length
        if. vx<0.0 do.
            ux =. -ux
            uy =. -uy
        end.
    end.
    angle =. ((12 o.ux j.uy)*180.0)%Pi
    leading,trailing,ux,uy,angle,(%:leading),(%:trailing),(Pi*%:leading*trailing),b%%:a*c
)
bhattacharyya =: 4 : 0
    cov =. ((3}.x)+3}.y)%2.0
    average =. (3{.x),cov
    ratio =. (determinant cov)%%:(determinant 3}.x)*determinant 3}.y
    distance =. ((1 2{y)mahalanobis average)%8.0
    distance =. distance+(^.ratio)%2.0
    distance,^-distance
)

distance2 =: 4 : '+/*:x-y'
distance =: 4 : '%:x distance2 y'
assign_centers =: 4 : 0
    result =. i.0
    for_point. x do.
        distances =. i.0
        for_center. y do.
            distances =. distances,point distance2 center
        end.
        result =. result,distances i.<./distances
    end.
    result
)
run_kmeans =: 3 : 0
    'points centers maximum' =. y
    labels =. points assign_centers centers
    count =. #centers
    iterations =. 0
    for_iteration. 1+i.maximum do.
        updated =. 0 2$0.0
        for_k. i.count do.
            total =. 2$0.0
            size =. 0
            for_i. i.#points do.
                if. k=i{labels do.
                    total =. total+i{points
                    size =. size+1
                end.
            end.
            center =. k{centers
            if. size do.
                center =. total%size
            end.
            updated =. updated,center
        end.
        centers =. updated
        next_labels =. points assign_centers centers
        same =. labels-:next_labels
        labels =. next_labels
        iterations =. iteration
        if. same do.
            break.
        end.
    end.
    inertia =. 0.0
    sizes =. count$0
    for_i. i.#points do.
        k =. i{labels
        sizes =. (1+k{sizes)k}sizes
        inertia =. inertia+(i{points)distance2 k{centers
    end.
    (<centers),(<labels),(<iterations),(<inertia),<sizes
)

winner =: 3 : 'y i.>./y'
row_entropy =: 3 : 0
    total =. 0.0
    for_value. y do.
        if. value>0.0 do.
            total =. total+value*^.value
        end.
    end.
    -total
)
parameter_count =: 4 : 0
    select. x
    case. 'FULL' do. (6*y)-1
    case. 'TIED' do. (3*y)+2
    case. 'DIAG' do. (5*y)-1
    case. do. (4*y)-1
    end.
)
fit =: 4 : 0
    points =. x
    'initial count kind type_index' =. y
    'model records densities trace' =. run_em (<points),(<initial),(<kind),(<Iterations),<Epsilon
    p =. kind parameter_count count
    loglik =. {:trace
    bic =. (-2.0*loglik)+p*^.#points
    aic =. (-2.0*loglik)+2*p
    labels =. i.0
    sizes =. count$0
    entropy =. 0.0
    for_row. records do.
        k =. winner row
        labels =. labels,k
        sizes =. (1+k{sizes)k}sizes
        entropy =. entropy+row_entropy row
    end.
    icl =. bic+2.0*entropy
    settled =. <: #trace
    for_t. |.i.#trace do.
        if. (|(t{trace)-loglik)>Tolerance do.
            break.
        end.
        settled =. t
    end.
    largest_t =. 1
    largest_value =. __
    violations =. i.0
    for_t. 1+i.<:#trace do.
        previous =. (t-1){trace
        current =. t{trace
        increase =. current-previous
        if. increase>largest_value do.
            largest_t =. t
            largest_value =. increase
        end.
        if. current<previous-0.000001*|previous do.
            violations =. violations,t
        end.
    end.
    (<model),(<records),(<densities),(<trace),(<count),(<kind),(<type_index),(<p),(<loglik),(<bic),(<aic),(<icl),(<labels),(<sizes),(<entropy),(<settled),(<largest_t),(<largest_value),<violations
)
ranking =: 4 : 0
    indices =. y
    keys =. 0 4$0x
    for_index. indices do.
        model =. index{::Models
        keys =. keys,(4 scaled (9+x){::model),(7{::model),(4{::model),6{::model
    end.
    indices /: keys
)

    indices =. i.0
    for_i. i.#Models do.
        if. y=4{::i{::Models do.
            indices =. indices,i
        end.
    end.
    indices
)
by_kind =: 3 : 0
    indices =. i.0
    for_i. i.#Models do.
        if. y-:5{::i{::Models do.
            indices =. indices,i

)
contingency =: 3 : 0
    'left right rows columns' =. y
    matrix =. (rows,columns)$0x
    for_i. i.#left do.
        position =. <(i{left),i{right
        matrix =. (1+position{matrix)position}matrix
    end.
    matrix
)
choose2 =: 3 : '(y*(y-1))intdiv 2'
ari =: 3 : 0
    'left right rows columns' =. y
    matrix =. contingency y
    shared =. +/,choose2 matrix
    a =. +/choose2 +/"1 matrix
    b =. +/choose2 +/matrix
    z =. choose2 #left
    numerator =. 2*((z*shared)-a*b)
    denominator =. (z*(a+b))-2*a*b
    if. denominator=0 do.
        numerator =. 1x
        denominator =. 1x
    else.
        if. denominator<0 do.
            numerator =. -numerator
            denominator =. -denominator
        end.
        divisor =. (|numerator)+.denominator
        numerator =. numerator intdiv divisor
        denominator =. denominator intdiv divisor
    end.
    (integer numerator),'/',(integer denominator),' ',dec (0.0+numerator)%denominator
)
partition_metrics =: 4 : 0
    'labels count' =. y
    points =. x
    sample_size =. #points
    sizes =. count$0
    centers =. (count,2)$0.0
    occupied =. i.0
    center =. 2$0.0
    for_point. points do.
        center =. center+point
    end.
    center =. center%sample_size
    for_k. i.count do.
        total =. 2$0.0
        size =. 0
        for_i. i.sample_size do.
            if. k=i{labels do.
                total =. total+i{points
                size =. size+1
            end.
        end.
        sizes =. size k}sizes
        if. size do.
            occupied =. occupied,k
            centers =. (total%size)k}centers
        end.
    end.
    cluster =. count$0.0
    if. (#occupied)<2 do.
        (<0),(<0.0),(<0.0),(<0.0),<cluster return.
    end.
    silhouette =. 0.0
    for_i. i.sample_size do.
        own =. i{labels
        own_sum =. 0.0
        nearest =. _
        for_k. occupied do.
            total =. 0.0
            for_j. i.sample_size do.
                if. (k=j{labels)*.j~:i do.
                    total =. total+(i{points)distance j{points
                end.
            end.
            if. k=own do.
                own_sum =. total
            else.
                nearest =. nearest<.total%k{sizes
            end.
        end.
        score =. 0.0
        if. (own{sizes)>1 do.
            a =. own_sum%(own{sizes)-1
            score =. (nearest-a)%(a>.nearest)
        end.
        silhouette =. silhouette+score
        cluster =. (score+own{cluster)own}cluster
    end.
    between =. 0.0
    within =. 0.0
    scatter =. count$0.0
    for_k. occupied do.
        cluster =. ((k{cluster)%k{sizes)k}cluster
        between =. between+(k{sizes)*(k{centers)distance2 center
        total =. 0.0
        for_i. i.sample_size do.
            if. k=i{labels do.
                total =. total+(i{points)distance k{centers
            end.
        end.
        scatter =. (total%k{sizes)k}scatter
    end.
    for_i. i.sample_size do.
        within =. within+(i{points)distance2 (i{labels){centers
    end.
    groups =. #occupied
    ch =. (between%(groups-1))%(within%(sample_size-groups))
    db =. 0.0
    for_k. occupied do.
        worst =. __
        for_other. occupied do.
            if. other~:k do.
                candidate =. ((k{scatter)+other{scatter)%(k{centers)distance other{centers
                worst =. worst>.candidate
            end.
        end.
        db =. db+worst
    end.
    (<1),(<silhouette%sample_size),(<ch),(<db%groups),<cluster
)
metric_text =: 4 : 0
    if. -.0{::y do.
        '-' return.
    end.
    dec (x+1){::y
)
cluster_statistics =: 4 : 0
    clusters =. x
    total =. 0.0
    sizes =. (#clusters)$0
    for_row. y do.
        probabilities =. i.0
        for_cluster. clusters do.
            probability =. 0.0
            for_k. >cluster do.
                probability =. probability+k{row
            end.
            probabilities =. probabilities,probability
        end.
        total =. total+row_entropy probabilities
        k =. winner probabilities
        sizes =. (1+k{sizes)k}sizes
    end.
    (<total),<sizes
)
merge_clusters =: 4 : 0
    'first second' =. x
    result =. 0$a:
    for_j. i.#y do.
        if. j=second do.
            continue.
        end.
        cluster =. j{::y
        if. j=first do.
            cluster =. /:~cluster,second{::y
        end.
        result =. result,<cluster
    end.
    result
)

        fitted =. >fitted

        block =. (<'model K=',(integer count),' type=',kind),(<'parameters ',integer p),(<'loglik ',dec loglik),(<'bic ',dec bic),(<'aic ',dec aic),(<'icl ',dec icl),(<'mean_entropy ',dec entropy%#Points),(<'settled_at ',integer settled),(<'largest_increase iteration ',(integer largest_t),' value ',dec largest_value),(<'violations ',integer #violations),<'sizes ',integers sizes
        for_k. i.count do.
            component =. k{model
            geometry =. eigen_data 3}.component
            block =. block,<'component ',(integer k+1),' weight ',(dec 0{component),' mean ',(values 1 2{component),' cov ',(values 3}.component),' axes ',(values 5 6{geometry),' angle ',dec 4{geometry
        end.

        end.

    'models.txt'write_blocks blocks

    labels =. 12{::Selected
    records =. 1{::Selected
    densities =. 2{::Selected
    km_labels =. 1{::SelectedMeans
    assignments =. <'id,component,max_responsibility,log_density,kmeans_cluster'
    for_i. i.#Points do.
        assignments =. assignments,<(i{::Ids),',',(integer 1+i{labels),',',(dec >./i{records),',',(dec i{densities),',',integer 1+i{km_labels
    end.

)
rankings_and_partitions =: 3 : 0
    SelectionBlocks =: 0$a:
    block =. (<'ranking by bic'),<'rank K type parameters loglik bic delta_bic aic aic_rank icl icl_rank'
    for_j. i.#BicRanking do.
        index =. j{BicRanking
        fitted =. index{::Models
        'model records densities trace count kind type_index p loglik bic aic icl labels sizes entropy settled largest_t largest_value violations' =. fitted
        delta =. ((4 scaled bic)-4 scaled 9{::Selected)%10000.0
        block =. block,<(integer j+1),' ',(integer count),' ',kind,' ',(integer p),' ',(dec loglik),' ',(dec bic),' ',(dec delta),' ',(dec aic),' ',(integer 1+AicRanking i.index),' ',(dec icl),' ',integer 1+IclRanking i.index
    end.
    names =. ;:'selected best_aic best_icl'
    indices =. ({.BicRanking),({.AicRanking),{.IclRanking
    for_j. i.3 do.
        fitted =. (j{indices){::Models
        block =. block,<(j{::names),' K=',(integer 4{::fitted),' type=',5{::fitted
    end.
    SelectionBlocks =: SelectionBlocks,<block
    block =. <'best K per type'
    for_kind. Types do.
        indices =. by_kind >kind
        best =. 0$a:
        for_criterion. i.3 do.
            index =. {.criterion ranking indices
            best =. best,<integer 4{::index{::Models
        end.
        block =. block,<(>kind),' bic ',(0{::best),' aic ',(1{::best),' icl ',2{::best
    end.
    SelectionBlocks =: SelectionBlocks,<block
    best_models =. 0$a:
    for_index. i.#Ks do.
        count =. index{Ks
        best =. ({.0 ranking by_count count){::Models
        best_models =. best_models,<best
        km =. index{::Means
        gm_stats =. Points partition_metrics (12{best),<count
        km_stats =. Points partition_metrics (1{km),<count
        block =. (<'K=',(integer count),' type=',(5{::best),' bic ',dec 9{::best),(<'  kmeans iterations ',(integer 2{::km),' inertia ',dec 3{::km),<'  ari ',ari (12{best),(1{km),(<count),<count
        metric_names =. ;:'silhouette calinski_harabasz davies_bouldin'
        for_key. i.3 do.
            block =. block,<'  ',(key{::metric_names),' gmm ',(key metric_text gm_stats),' kmeans ',key metric_text km_stats
        end.
        if. index do.
            previous =. (index-1){::best_models
            matrix =. contingency (12{previous),(12{best),(4{previous),<count
            parents =. 0$a:
            shares =. i.0
            for_k. i.count do.
                counts =. k{"1 matrix
                largest =. >./counts
                parent =. '-'
                if. largest do.
                    parent =. integer 1+counts i.largest
                end.
                parents =. parents,<parent
                shares =. shares,largest
            end.
            block =. block,<'  parents K=',(integer 4{::previous),' ',(' 'join parents),' shared ',integers shares
        end.
        SelectionBlocks =: SelectionBlocks,<block
    end.
    block =. <'violations'
    for_fitted. Models do.
        fitted =. >fitted
        for_t. 18{::fitted do.
            trace =. 3{::fitted
            block =. block,<'K=',(integer 4{::fitted),' type=',(5{::fitted),' iteration ',(integer t),' previous ',(dec (t-1){trace),' current ',dec t{trace
        end.
    end.
    if. 1=#block do.
        block =. block,<'none'
    end.
    SelectionBlocks =: SelectionBlocks,<block
    i.0
)
components_and_overlap =: 3 : 0
    model =. 0{::Selected
    records =. 1{::Selected
    labels =. 12{::Selected
    sizes =. 13{::Selected
    count =. 4{::Selected
    stats =. Points partition_metrics (<labels),<count
    block =. <'selected components'
    for_k. i.count do.
        component =. k{model
        geometry =. eigen_data 3}.component
        observed =. (1+#GofEdges)$0
        soft =. 0.0
        inside_one =. 0
        inside_two =. 0
        for_i. i.#Points do.
            soft =. soft+(<i,k){records
            if. k=i{labels do.
                q =. (i{Points)mahalanobis component
                inside_one =. inside_one+q<:1.0
                inside_two =. inside_two+q<:4.0
                rho =. %:q
                bucket =. +/rho>:GofEdges
                observed =. (1+bucket{observed)bucket}observed
            end.
        end.
        expected =. i.0
        left =. 0.0
        chi =. 0.0
        for_j. i.#observed do.
            end_probability =. 0.0
            if. j<#GofEdges do.
                right =. j{GofEdges
                end_probability =. ^(-right*right)%2.0
